card.name: Dosing words in timing instructions
card.fires_on: Words inside dosing instructions, such as 'time' in 'same time each day', 'dose' or 'dosing' after 'recommended' or 'interval', and partway through drug names. It fires where the next word would be about timing or schedule.

modes.label: Time and dose words
modes.description: The word time, dose, dosing or injections within a schedule instruction.
modes.example: The dose should be administered at approximately the same<< time>> each day.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of drug names such as ustekinumab or mifepristone.

modes.label: Gap in a count
modes.description: Blank space before a patient count in a trial result.
